about: REPORT §4bk: how plainly each task's right lesson fits the defect the task file states, for the 20 tasks whose right lesson reached no sub-agent in either §4bj session, and the six whose sub-agent called the change not broken in both sessions and both failed. plain: the lesson's rule is the defect's mechanism; moderate: the mechanism matches but on another surface than the lesson's wording names; arguable or loose: as each line says.
classifier: an agent (Claude), reading each lesson as the review showed it beside the task file's one-line defect, after the run was scored; the architecture review of #480 read the same pairs and reached about 12 plain and 6 to 7 moderate among the 20
